answer: Proposal: cap demand, not faces. Payouts release only the escrow behind each job, and consumers mint acceptance credits capped at M per epoch per funding-ancestry root, shared by all accounts that root feeds. An ocean of masks on one treasury still mints M, not N×M: headcount adds bills, not share. The cap resets each epoch's tide, so extra roots cost fresh escrow, linear; a root earns only if its slice clears upkeep. The rule sits in marble — public state, no issuer — but mixers blur ancestry: laundering is the seam.
